ls=[l for l in B.split('\n') if l and not l.startswith('#')]; hdr=ls[0].split(); SM={}
for l in ls[1:]:
    p=l.split()

def sw(a,b,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(a),len(b); NEG=-1e9
    Ms=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    sub=np.array([[SM.get((x,y),-4) for y in b] for x in a],float); best=0.0;bi=bj=0
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        r=sub[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            c=(Ms[i-1,j-1],Ix[i-1,j-1],Iy[i-1,j-1]);k=int(np.argmax(c));v=c[k]+r[j-1]
            if v<0: v=0.0;k=3
            Ms[i,j]=v;pM[i,j]=k
            if v>best: best=v;bi,bj=i,j
            c=(Ms[i-1,j]+go,Ix[i-1,j]+ge,Iy[i-1,j]+go);k=int(np.argmax(c));Ix[i,j]=c[k];pX[i,j]=k
            c=(Ms[i,j-1]+go,Ix[i,j-1]+go,Iy[i,j-1]+ge);k=int(np.argmax(c));Iy[i,j]=c[k];pY[i,j]=k
    i,j=bi,bj;st=0;A=[];Bv=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if st==0:
            if pM[i,j]==3: break
            A.append(a[i-1]);Bv.append(b[j-1]);ns=pM[i,j];i-=1;j-=1;st=ns
        elif st==1: A.append(a[i-1]);Bv.append('-');ns=pX[i,j];i-=1;st=ns
        else: A.append('-');Bv.append(b[j-1]);ns=pY[i,j];j-=1;st=ns
    return ''.join(reversed(A)),''.join(reversed(Bv)),best,i+1,j+1
def kabsch(P,Q):
    Pc=P.mean(0);Qc=Q.mean(0);H=(P-Pc).T@(Q-Qc);U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T));R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,d])@U.T
    return R,Qc-R@Pc
t2o={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def ppdb(t):
    at=[]
    for l in t.split('\n'):
        if l.startswith(('ATOM','HETATM')):
            try: at.append(dict(rec=l[:6].strip(),name=l[12:16].strip(),alt=l[16],resn=l[17:20].strip(),ch=l[21],
                resi=int(l[22:26]),xyz=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])]),
                b=float(l[60:66]) if l[60:66].strip() else 0.0))
            except ValueError: pass
    return at

plddt={a['resi']:a['b'] for a in af if a['name']=='CA'}

    res[pid]=dict(all=at,ca={a['resi']:a['xyz'] for a in ats if a['name']=='CA'},
        seq={a['resi']:t2o.get(a['resn'],'X') for a in ats if a['name']=='CA'},

maps={}
for pid,win in [('1HS6',(200,480)),('3MDJ',(250,560))]:
    keys=sorted(k for k in res[pid]['ca'] if win[0]<=k<=win[1]); ts=''.join(res[pid]['seq'][k] for k in keys)
    A,Bv,sc,si,sj=sw(AOP[329:700],ts); ai=329+si-1; bj=sj-2; pr=[]
    for x,y in zip(A,Bv):
        if x!='-': ai+=1
        if y!='-': bj+=1
        if x!='-' and y!='-': pr.append((ai,keys[bj]))
    R,t=kabsch(np.array([af_ca[x] for x,y in pr]),np.array([res[pid]['ca'][y] for x,y in pr]))
    afk=sorted(af_ca); tk=sorted(res[pid]['ca'])
    for it in range(12):
        P=np.array([R@af_ca[k]+t for k in afk]); Q=np.array([res[pid]['ca'][k] for k in tk])
        D=np.linalg.norm(P[:,None]-Q[None],axis=2); i2j=D.argmin(1); j2i=D.argmin(0)
        mut=[(a,b) for a,b in enumerate(i2j) if j2i[b]==a and D[a,b]<5.0]
        R,t=kabsch(np.array([af_ca[afk[a]] for a,b in mut]),np.array([res[pid]['ca'][tk[b]] for a,b in mut]))
    rm=np.sqrt(((np.array([R@af_ca[afk[a]]+t for a,b in mut])-np.array([res[pid]['ca'][tk[b]] for a,b in mut]))**2).sum(1).mean())
    maps[pid]=dict(R=R,t=t,rmsd=rm,n=len(mut),t2a={tk[b]:afk[a] for a,b in mut},a2t={afk[a]:tk[b] for a,b in mut})
    print(f'{pid}: {len(mut)} pairs RMSD {rm:.2f}')
